sentences.text: Today we talk about a small and special city. The city is Lamu. Lamu is in Kenya. Kenya is a country in East Africa.
Lamu is on a small island in the Indian Ocean. Lamu is a very old town with a long history. It is calm, beautiful and full of culture. Part 2.
Lamu is more than 700 years old. It is one of the oldest towns in Kenya.
Because of this history, the culture of Lamu is very unique. You can see African, Arab and Asian influences in the town.
Part 3. The old town of Lamu is very special. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The streets are very narrow.
There are many small houses and old buildings. The houses are made of coral stone and wood. Walking in the old town feels peaceful and quiet.
Part 4. One interesting thing about Lamu is transportation. There are almost no cars in the town.
Instead, people walk or use donkeys for transportation. Donkeys carry goods and help people move around the island.
Part 5. The architecture in Lamu is beautiful. Many houses have large wooden doors with detailed designs.
These doors are handmade and very artistic. Many buildings also have balconies and inner courtyards.
These designs help keep the houses cool in the hot weather.
Part 6. Lamu is near the ocean, so the sea is an important part of life.
Many people work as fishermen. Traditional wooden boats called dows sail in the water.
These boats have large white sails and move slowly with the wind.
Part 7. The beaches near Lamu are beautiful and quiet. The sand is white and the water is blue.
Visitors enjoy swimming, walking on the beach, and watching the sunset. The atmosphere is calm and relaxing.
Part 8. Food in Lamu is influenced by many cultures. People eat rice, fish, coconut, and spices.
One popular dish is coconut rice with fish. Another popular drink is fresh coconut juice.
The food is simple but very tasty. Part 9. The people in Lamu are friendly and welcoming.
Many families have lived on the island for generations. Life in the town is slow and peaceful.
Neighbors often talk with each other in the streets. Part 10.
Every year, Lamu hosts a famous festival called the Lamu Cultural Festival.
During the festival, there is music, dancing, and traditional clothing.
There are also donkey races and dowsailing competitions.
Visitors from many countries come to enjoy the festival.
Part 11. Nature around Lamu is very beautiful.
There are mangrove forests, small islands, and blue ocean water.
Birds and marine animals live in the area.
